nodes.name: Claude for Financial Services.md

nodes.name: build-spec.md
nodes.summary: Hackathon build specification for 'The Syndicate Squad' — a wallet-native multi-agent office system where a supervisor assembles, funds, evaluates, and upgrades agent teams under treasury policy constraints. Defines MVP screens, domain model (MissionRecord, AgentIdentity, TreasuryRequest, etc.), demo flow, and frontend/integration architecture using Next.js, OWS, XMTP, and x402.
